name: Little Survivors

text.trigger: A non-exiled survivor ends a move at a location with no other survivors.
text.vignette: Tiny boot prints cross the stairwell dust and end at a boiler room door. When the survivor calls out, a handful of faces appear behind a stack of crates, quiet and watchful, as if they have practised hiding for a long time.

options.bring-them-home: Take them with you: add 3 helpless survivors to the colony and raise morale by 1.
options.leave-supplies: Leave some cans and go. Nothing happens.

notes: src: Crossroad_cards_v1.1.xlsx.txt card #28; the engine will not trigger it while the colony is full (R11.3)
